title: Amylaceous
summary: AMYLA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin amylum, starch, of a priv. and a mill, being formerly made without grinding.] Pertaining to starch, or the farinaceous part of grain; resembling starch.

inlines.v: AMYLA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin amylum, starch, of a priv. and a mill, being formerly made without grinding.] Pertaining to starch, or the farinaceous part of grain; resembling starch.
